turns.text: Yeah, if the sun comes out, Leah and I might walk around the Stone Arch Bridge area tomorrow to capture some shots. It'll just be nice to spend some quality time together after being so busy.

turns.text: That sounds like a wonderful weekend plan. The Stone Arch Bridge always makes for some fantastic photos, especially with the Minneapolis skyline in the background. I hope you two have a relaxing evening!
